verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's core inference features (chat completions, embeddings, image/video, speech, vision) are all documented as API-first, OpenAI-compatible endpoints with granular parameters (service_tier, fail_fast, reasoning_effort, tools), suggesting most functionality is API-accessible. However, dedicated deployments and GPU clusters are described as 'deployable in just a few clicks' (implying console/UI action) without explicit API endpoints shown for deployment/management, and probes show no published OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, undermining full API-parity discoverability. missing for 10: explicit statement of UI/API feature parity, documented API calls for deploying dedicated instances or clusters, a published OpenAPI/swagger spec confirming full surface area.
